blocks.text: The Mughal advance is briefly diverted through Ghumanda, an Uppal Jat by caste, who outwardly guides Moman Khan’s men yet secretly sends word that Tara Singh should vacate his place with his companions before the force closes in.
Tara Singh refuses the offer of safety because he has already resolved to make a sacrifice, treating withdrawal as a betrayal of the witness he intends to give.
The page closes by showing the Singhs openly challenged the Mughals with the beat of a drum, a defiant signal that their stand has been chosen rather than forced upon them.
